interest: Documents US monitoring of Japanese propaganda in Chile, including Manchukuo films and pamphlets, and Colonel Chikaido Okada's 1938 visit.
overview: Docket (Form DS-46, 1945) for 894.20225, 1932-39: seven items from Santiago (Norweb, Armour) and Valparaíso on Japanese propaganda about Manchuria and the 'China Affair', Manchukuo films, Emperor Hirohito's birthday coverage, Osaka YMCA materials, and Colonel Chikaido Okada's 1938 visit; cross-referenced to decimal files 793.94, 825.4061, and 810.00.

subfiles.about: A two-page State Department docket sheet indexing reports on Japanese propaganda, military intelligence, and cultural diplomacy in Chile between 1932 and 1939.
subfiles.summary: Seven despatches and reports (1932-39), filed under 894.20225, from US officials in Santiago and Valparaíso on Japanese propaganda regarding Manchuria and the 'China Affair', Manchukuo films, Hirohito's birthday coverage, Osaka YMCA material, and Colonel Chikaido Okada's September 1938 visit; cross-filed to decimal classifications 793.94, 825.4061, and 810.00.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Japanese Military Activities in Chile (894.20225, Sub Nos. 6-12)
